snippet.title: Marathon: Istoria [TRAILER]
snippet.description:
Marathon: Istoria v1.1 is available now:

Get on the Infinity Steam Workshop: [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3312760415]
Download on Lochnits: [https://lochnits.com/marathon/istoria/]
Simplici7y page: [https://simplici7y.com/items/marathon-istoria/]
Download on Mod DB: [https://www.moddb.com/mods/marathon-istoria]
Soundtrack: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WXuOVl4zA_E]

Marathon: Istoria is an Aleph One RPG scenario that takes place in Bungie's Marathon universe and features a 10 level campaign, seven player classes with active and passive abilities, nine new spells, on-demand energy cans, the ability to talk to the dead, lootable bodies, and more. Istoria makes use of Aleph One's three additional Lua hotkeys to allow the player many more options in combat strategies.

Istoria features new landscapes, new and updated textures, as well as textures from Marathon 2 and Infinity. Several enemies display new and challenging behaviors through Lua scripting. Levels can be revisited later if need be.

Istoria Credits:

Created by: W'rkncacnter and Windbreaker
Level Design: Windbreaker
Scripting: W'rkncacnter and Jon Irons
Graphics: W'rkncacnter, Windbreaker, and Jon Irons
Story: Windbreaker, W'rkncacnter, and Jon Irons
Soundtrack: Jon Irons (including trailer song: "Frog Crush")
